name: v0.66.1
body:
Installation and signature verification

 ### Installation #### By downloading binary from the release For instance, if you are using Linux on an AMD64 architecture: ```shell # Download the binary curl -LO https://github.com/carvel-dev/kapp/releases/download/v0.66.1/kapp-linux-amd64 # Move the binary in to your PATH mv kapp-linux-amd64 /usr/local/bin/kapp # Make the binary executable chmod +x /usr/local/bin/kapp ``` #### Via Homebrew (macOS or Linux) ```shell $ brew tap carvel-dev/carvel $ brew install kapp $ kapp version ``` ### Verify checksums file signature The checksums file provided within the artifacts attached to this release is signed using [Cosign](https://docs.sigstore.dev/cosign/overview/) with GitHub OIDC(Refer [this](https://docs.sigstore.dev/system_config/installation/) page for cosign installation). To validate the signature of this file, run the following commands: ```shell # Download the checksums file, certificate and signature curl -LO https://github.com/carvel-dev/kapp/releases/download/v0.66.1/checksums.txt curl -LO https://github.com/carvel-dev/kapp/releases/download/v0.66.1/checksums.txt.pem curl -LO https://github.com/carvel-dev/kapp/releases/download/v0.66.1/checksums.txt.sig # Verify the checksums file cosign verify-blob checksums.txt \ --certificate checksums.txt.pem \ --signature checksums.txt.sig \ --certificate-identity-regexp=https://github.com/carvel-dev \ --certificate-oidc-issuer=https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com ``` ### Verify binary integrity To verify the integrity of the downloaded binary, you can utilize the checksums file after having validated its signature. ```shell # Verify the binary using the checksums file sha256sum -c checksums.txt --ignore-missing ```
## What's Changed * feat: add deployment flag for printing out the graph of resources by @erikmiller-gusto in https://github.com/carvel-dev/kapp/pull/1064 * Migrate ytt dependency to carvel.dev/ytt by @Siegfriedk in https://github.com/carvel-dev/kapp/pull/1102 * Bump golang 1.25.6 by @CodesbyUnnati in https://github.com/carvel-dev/kapp/pull/1107 * Bump k8s to 1.35 to fix CVEs by @CodesbyUnnati in https://github.com/carvel-dev/kapp/pull/1108 * Replace hardcoded shebangs with /usr/bin/env for portability by @Lillecarl in https://github.com/carvel-dev/kapp/pull/1105 * Bump k8s.io/apimachinery from 0.35.0 to 0.35.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/carvel-dev/kapp/pull/1113 * Bump k8s.io/apiextensions-apiserver from 0.35.0 to 0.35.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/carvel-dev/kapp/pull/1112 * Bump k8s.io/kubernetes from 1.35.0 to 1.35.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/carvel-dev/kapp/pull/1111 * Bump github.com/hashicorp/go-version to v1.7.0 by @G-Gobi in https://github.com/carvel-dev/kapp/pull/1128 * Fix long CRD change group validation by @guettli in https://github.com/carvel-dev/kapp/pull/1124 * Retrieve the latest kindest/node image for tests by @joaopapereira in https://github.com/carvel-dev/kapp/pull/1120 * Return an error instead of panicking on a non-map array element by @arpitjain099 in https://github.com/carvel-dev/kapp/pull/1132 * Bump golang.org/x/net from 0.47.0 to 0.50.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/carvel-dev/kapp/pull/1115 * Migrate kapp-controller dependency to carvel.dev/kapp-controller by @Siegfriedk in https://github.com/carvel-dev/kapp/pull/1121 * bump go to 1.27 by @AshishNaware in https://github.com/carvel-dev/kapp/pull/1138 * Bump dependencies by @praveenrewar in https://github.com/carvel-dev/kapp/pull/1139 ## New Contributors * @erikmiller-gusto made their first contribution in https://github.com/carvel-dev/kapp/pull/1064 * @Siegfriedk made their first contribution in https://github.com/carvel-dev/kapp/pull/1102 * @Lillecarl made their first contribution in https://github.com/carvel-dev/kapp/pull/1105 * @G-Gobi made their first contribution in https://github.com/carvel-dev/kapp/pull/1128 * @guettli made their first contribution in https://github.com/carvel-dev/kapp/pull/1124 * @arpitjain099 made their first contribution in https://github.com/carvel-dev/kapp/pull/1132 * @AshishNaware made their first contribution in https://github.com/carvel-dev/kapp/pull/1138 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/carvel-dev/kapp/compare/v0.65.4...v0.66.1 ##
